findings.title: Commit 41382521 falsely claims lifecycle:llm:dispatched deployed to container
findings.analysis: Commit 41382521 (19:39Z) updated the super-repo ias-executor-ts submodule pointer from 9a7e0b2 to 8cfa16f and claims in its message: 'Deployed to all 7 vessel node_modules in substrate container; goal-host-vessel restarted healthy.' The claim is false. Container's /vessels/ias-executor-ts/src/resolvers/llm-prompt.ts has 118 lines matching commit 9a7e0b2 (inputImpulses fix); commit 8cfa16f (lifecycle:llm:dispatched) would produce 139 lines. The container's goal-host-vessel WAS restarted at 19:45Z (confirmed via journalctl) but the restart did not pick up the 8cfa16f code because /vessels/ias-executor-ts/ was not updated before the restart. The super-repo submodule pointer now points to 8cfa16f but the running container has 9a7e0b2. This is a discrepancy between committed pointer and deployed code. Consequence: lifecycle:llm:dispatched is NOT available for audit verification of the inputImpulses fix as claimed by investigation-027. The inputImpulses fix (9a7e0b2) IS deployed and IS working.
